text: And there's much more than this. Waitlists and invitations, on every event you run. Revenue and V A T, worked out for you. Your own venues, with their own seating maps. And every ticket and attendee in one place.
Revel. Your events, your community, your data. It's free, it's open source, and you can host it yourself. Come and build with us, at lets revel dot io.
